definitions.explanation: Making up for loss, damage, or injury, often financially.

examples.japanese: ⟦{被害者|ひがいしゃ}→ひがいしゃ：14106_higaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{補償|ほしょう}⟦{金|きん}→きん：02666_kin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{支払|しはら}われた→しはらう：02116_shiharau⟧。
examples.english: Compensation was paid to the victims.

examples.japanese: ⟦{損害|そんがい}→そんがい：02615_songai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{補償|ほしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{労働|ろうどう}→ろうどう：03785_roudou⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→さいがい：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{補償|ほしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→うける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I received compensation for the workplace injury.

notes:
Used specifically for making up for damages or losses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {補償|ほしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to compensate)
- {補償|ほしょう}⟦{金|きん}→きん：02666_kin⟧ (compensation money)
- ⟦{損害|そんがい}→そんがい：02615_songai⟧{補償|ほしょう} (damage compensation)
- {補償|ほしょう}⟦{制度|せいど}→せいど：03291_seido⟧ (compensation system)
- ⟦{被害|ひがい}→ひがい：02572_higai⟧{補償|ほしょう} (victim compensation)

HOMOPHONES (all ほしょう):
- ⟦{保証|ほしょう}→ほしょう：03718_hoshou⟧ - guarantee (for products, promises)
- ⟦{保障|ほしょう}→ほしょう：03719_hoshou⟧ - security, protection (for rights, systems)
- {補償|ほしょう} - compensation (for damages)

MEMORY TIP:
{補償|ほしょう} uses {補|ほ} (supplement/compensate) - filling in what was lost
